svg.aria-label: ESHANA: one JSON entry point, three thin shells
svg.title: ESHANA: one JSON entry point, three thin shells

g.text: ESHANA: one JSON entry point, three thin shells
Every surface calls Engine::execute_json, so the CLI, the Python package and the HTML report cannot disagree.
1 · A request names an instant (UTC, or civil time plus zone) and the settings used
2 · The instant becomes TT and UT time scales and Julian dates
3 · A provider returns apparent ecliptic positions in one frame
4 · Rule packs derive signs, houses, nakshatra, dasha and gates; each value is labelled
5 · The CLI prints the envelope as JSON
6 · Python returns the same data as a dict or a Chart
7 · The report renderer turns the envelope into one self-contained HTML file
